description: Adds a comment (plain text, line breaks allowed, max 10000 characters) to a task, signed by the connected account. The comment is visible to the project's members and, if the project owner configured webhooks or chat notifications for the project, it is also sent there. mentions: names or emails of project members; people outside the project are ignored. Mentions do not send notifications. Calling it twice posts two comments. Requires write permission.

mentions.description: Names or emails of project members to mention.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

task.description: Task reference: its key (the 'rif' column, e.g. 'Cronos-12'), its uuid, 'wbs:1.2', or its exact name if unique.

name: planitude_add_comment
title: Add task comment
